stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India is discussing a proposal to classify demat accounts with no activity for two years as dormant. The move aims to align demat accounts with trading accounts and prevent potential misuse. Investors may need to complete verification formalities before resuming transactions.

stories.title: Tribunal orders fresh probe into Coffee Day fund diversion
stories.summary: The Securities Appellate Tribunal has directed the Securities and Exchange Board of India to conduct a fresh investigation into the alleged diversion of 3,535 crore rupees from Coffee Day Enterprises subsidiaries. The tribunal set aside a previous order and requested a new probe within six months.

stories.summary: Spain-based Kabilio has raised 10 million euros in a funding round led by Picus Capital and Visionaries. The company, which builds an AI platform for accounting firms, will use the capital to launch an AI agent that reads invoices and suggests bookkeeping entries for clients.

stories.title: NPCI launches technology subsidiary
stories.summary: The National Payments Corporation of India has established a wholly owned subsidiary, NPCI Tech Solutions, to expand its capabilities in AI, blockchain and digital financial infrastructure. stories.title: Gold ETF folios grow 164 percent in three years
stories.summary: Gold ETF folios grew 164 percent between September 2023 and September 2026, significantly outpacing the 30 percent growth seen in large-cap mutual fund folios. An analysis by OmniScience Capital suggests investors are increasingly chasing gold returns rather than following a disciplined asset allocation strategy.

stories.title: NSE promotes gold-backed EGRs for Dhanteras
stories.summary: The National Stock Exchange is urging investors to buy Electronic Gold Receipts instead of physical gold this Dhanteras. The exchange claims India could avoid 5 to 6 billion dollars in annual imports if gold funds held its EGRs, which are backed by recycled and refined physical gold.

stories.title: Karnataka and Arunachal Pradesh increase dearness allowance
stories.summary: Karnataka and Arunachal Pradesh have increased dearness allowance for employees and pensioners. Karnataka raised the allowance by 2.5 percent, while Arunachal Pradesh increased it by 3 percent. Both moves follow the Union Cabinet decision to hike the allowance for central government counterparts to 63 percent.

stories.title: Consumer commission rules against Union Bank in locker dispute
stories.summary: The Delhi State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission awarded 47 lakh rupees to a customer after Union Bank of India failed to prove a locker was surrendered voluntarily. The ruling highlights the importance of documentation and insurance for bank lockers. Banks are now expected to keep better records.

stories.title: Bengaluru landlord ordered to refund security deposit with interest
stories.summary: A consumer commission ordered a landlord to return an 80,000 rupee security deposit plus 9 percent annual interest and 10,000 rupees in litigation costs. The landlord failed to provide evidence of property damage or outstanding dues. The deposit is now officially required to be returned.

stories.title: Retail investors report 100 crore rupee loss in Stockal Securities incident
stories.summary: Nearly 30 retail investors lost over 100 crore rupees after their US stock portfolios were allegedly liquidated without authorization on the Stockal Securities platform. The firm is registered with SEBI and facilitates foreign investments. The platform has yet to explain how the portfolios were accessed.
